Nasik men anbad ke pas dattangar men, bhujal ke sainpals men prati litar heksavelent kromiyam ki bhari matra paee gaee hai jo, WHO ki or se tay vailyu se hazar guna jyada hai. ye pani pine ki vajah se logon ko jina behal ho gaya hai. logon ke sharir chhale se bhare hue hain to doktar kaee mahilaon ko pregnensi se bachne ki salah de rahe hain. is ilake़ men rahne valon ki zindgi par is pile pani ki vajah se buri tarah prabhavit ho chuki hai.
